mentl/2b83f83:
row_subsumes' EtAll arm promised that "a var that LATER grows is caught at
unify, where Open~All binds the var to the mask". Measured: it is not.
`fn run(f) with !E = f()` accepts `run(() => op())` and runs; so does the
`with Pure` gate; so does an unrelated `with !WASI`. A param's row var
reaching the gate through a call is never bound by the declaration it
passed. The comment is corrected in place.

The `!E` half is the new fact and it is crown-tier — the banked entry only
ever recorded the Pure case, which reads as over-permissive; the negation
leaking is §0's second property failing at the shape most likely to carry a
real negation.

The peer is stamped with the answer to the fork it was banked as. Branch A —
a declared row constrains its params' rows — is the Carried-Truth Law rather
than a choice: the graph already holds row(run) ⊇ row(f), the declaration
constrains row(run), and solving gives row(f) ⊆ declared. Annotating the
param refuses today, so the machinery works and only the propagation is
missing. Undeclared stays polymorphic, which is the gradient.

The site is infer's declared-row arm, where inference owns the write, never
row_subsumes — that is a read by contract, and rejecting a free tail there
is the twice-measured dead end of 646 false mismatches. The mechanism is
diff_row's mask edge, one function over.

Not measured, and it is the whole remaining risk: the population of declared
rows that would start refusing. The march's census is the instrument.
mentl/2baffc0:
A closure performing E, handed out of an arm through resume and called
under `with !E`, checked clean and ran — exit 7, the outer handler
answering. The same closure written inline was caught.

The root was not the resume site. Writing `with Pure` on the op's returned
fn type made the identical program refuse, which proved the subsumption
machinery is reached there and works; there was nothing to subsume under.
An unannotated fn type mints a free row var, and the directional meet fires
only on a concrete cap — deliberately, because a var-tailed param row is the
flow channel map's f needs and masking it once convicted 297 sites.

Variance is the rule. A parameter is a demand the caller fills, so its
unannotated row stays a var. A result is a promise about what the produced
value may do, so its unannotated row caps at Pure. Every other latency
carrier already behaved that way — field, list, tuple, variant, default
param, handler state.

cap_result_fn_row runs at register_one_op. The blast radius was measured
first and is empty: no op in src or lib declares a fn-typed return, which is
why this is one landing rather than an arc, and why the crucibles are its
only oracle — m3 == m4 cannot see a form the wheel never writes.

Three crown crucibles, all seen red first. The bare form — the one a person
types — ran at 7 before this and reports `E vs Pure` after.

absorb_into_residual's widening arm now reads the tail. Under RowAssumed or
RowContinues a new field still widens, because more may genuinely exist.
Under RowClosed the writer proved the residual IS the remainder, so a name
outside it is provably absent and the access is a type_mismatch — the same
verdict a closed record already gave. The tail landed two pins ago as a
projection; this is its first enforcement.

What it was doing is the worst version of the class, measured before the
edit. `let {a, ...rest} = ({a: 1, b: 2})` gives rest a residual of exactly
{b: Int}. `rest.nosuch` checked clean and ran to exit 0. Then `rest.aa` —
the name chosen to sort before the real field — ran to exit 2, which is b's
value: the widened layout put aa at offset 0 and the real residual keeps b
there. Not a missing refusal, an aliased read.

The control was always right, which makes this a restoration rather than a
new policy: the same unknown name on a plain closed record is
`E_TypeMismatch: { aa: … } vs { a: Int, b: Int }` at the access. The
residual path simply was not giving the verdict the record path gave.

The march settled the stamp's open line. Whether any wheel or lib site
leaned on the widening was unmeasured, and a new refusal class earns its
keep by surviving the self-compile.

mentl/2b3a8ae:
Continued tracing past the d1714f5 checkpoint pins the coordinated build's
first piece and de-risks the arc:

- The monomorphic_at gate is $row_is_ground treating a CLOSED row as
  needing no evidence. iterate_from's `with Iterate` is closed {Iterate},
  so it lowers as LCall (no evidence) when it must take LSuspend. "Closed"
  (no row variable) was conflated with "needs no handler" -- a remnant of
  the retired static-dispatch design. Fix: a call needs evidence iff its
  row has a handler-dispatched op (non-pure, minus builtin WASI/memory).

- Blocker 1 is NOT gated on Blocker 2 (type resolution): for row_is_ground
  to run, monomorphic_at already saw ty_tag==107 (TFun) at the iterate_from
  call -- the call type resolved. The evidence build is independent of the
  NFree gap.

Walkthrough sec 4.6 records the lands-together build order (monomorphic_at
-> derive_ev_slots -> LSuspend threading -> LEvPerform load -> offset
unification, seed then wheel) as the next focused arc.

turbosort/2b1bb38:
The original partition_u32 used isize/unsigned_abs() for the read/write
pointer "room" metric — fragile at boundaries. Fixed with correct unsigned
distance: left_room = read_left - write_left, right_room = write_right -
read_right (Bramas 2017 neutralize invariant). Quicksort now uses the SIMD
partition instead of the scalar fallback.

500-line budget. Removed dead histogram_u32 that did SIMD load + scalar
scatter (net zero benefit).
two-top/2bb4d20:
Compile-time-baked TWOTOP_TURN_* credentials are extractable from any
distributed binary, and the apk-latest release is a public download —
so the workflow must never wire those secrets in, even conditionally.
The public APK is STUN-only by design; TURN-enabled builds stay local
(scripts/phone.sh with the env set) or wait for short-lived credentials.
tokensafe/2b77048:
Two compounding bugs caused memecoins like TRUMP to score 0 (LOW):

1. DAS fallback returned accounts in arbitrary order (not by balance),
   producing fake 0.06% concentration (real: 91.5%). Removed entirely —
   RPC failure now returns UNAVAILABLE + uncertainty penalty.

2. Concentration scoring was too lenient: flat +15 for top10>50%,
   and top1 penalty skipped entirely when token had liquidity
   (unverified AMM vault assumption).

New graduated penalties:
- top_holders_10: >80% +25, >50% +20, >30% +10
- top_holders_1:  >50% +25, >30% +15, >20% +10, >10% +5
- No liquidity exemption (pool vault verification is future work)

TRUMP now scores ~50 (HIGH), USDC/USDT stay 5 (LOW).
393 tests pass, tsc clean.
